basic_details.job_title: HAL Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 6 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), a Maharatna Public Sector Undertaking under the Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence, has invited applications for 6 contract posts: 4 Consultant / Experimental Test Pilot (ETP) (Rotary Wing) and 2 Consultant / Flight Test Engineer (FTE) (Rotary Wing), at HAL Flight Operations (Rotary Wing), Bengaluru. Only superannuated Test Pilots and Flight Test Engineers from the Flying Branch of Indian Armed Forces / DRDO / NAL may apply. Applications go by email to the Deputy General Manager (HR) at [email protected], on or before 10 December 2026, th

age_limit.details: Upper age limit for both posts: 61 years as on 10.12.2026. The notice does not list any age relaxation.

More than 2000 flying hours on Rotary Wing Platforms, and current in flying. The latest break in flying on Helicopter, if any, should not exceed one year. At least two year of test-flying experience. Valid CPL(H) or ATPL(H). Preference will be given to candidates with any of: experience in production and prototype test flying; experience in weapons and EW trials; rotary-wing service qualifications such as QFI, HCL, RHS or CSQ. Appointment of the selected candidate is subject to a satisfactory medical report. The notice prints no rupee amount. | The engagement is initially for a period of one year and extendable based on requirements, on Full Time basis. The place of posting is HAL Flight Operations (Rotary Wing), Bengaluru. | For the full eligibility of each post, see the official notification PDF.

Candidates must produce the requisite documents for verification prior to the interview. The notice does not state the interview date or venue.
important_instructions: The engagement on contract basis will be purely temporary and will not confer any right or claim to the status, facilities or benefits of a regular employee of the Company. HAL reserves the right to cancel the notification and / or the selection process. The decision of the Company regarding selection will be final. content_sections.heading: About HAL
content_sections.text: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited describes itself as a Maharatna Public Sector Undertaking and a premier Aeronautics Complex in South Asia, under the Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence, Govt. of India. It operates with 20 Divisions and 10 R&D Centers across 7 states and 10 geographical locations. This is a government-sector company recruitment, and the engagement is on contract.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested candidates who meet the criteria send the application in the enclosed format, with copies of certificates, to the Deputy General Manager (HR), HAL Corporate Office, Bengaluru – 560 001, through the email ID [email protected] , on or before 10.12.2026. The application form is headed "Application for the post of Consultant / Experimental Test Pilot (Rotary Wing) / Consultant / Flight Test Engineer (Rotary Wing) at HAL, Flight Operations (Rotary Wing), Bengaluru (On Contract Basis)". Download the notification and the enclosed four-page application form from the official notification PDF. Fill in every field of the form; the form states that all fields are mandatory and that an application without the required details will be summarily rejected. Paste a self-attested recent passport size photograph on the form. Type a pen picture of about 500 words on a separate sheet (current or last position; professional experience, achievements and significant contribution) and enclose it. Attach copies of the Age, Qualification (ETP/FTE), Flying / Flight Test Experience and Service / Relieving certificates and the last drawn Pay Slip. Email the application to [email protected] so that it is received on or before 10.12.2026. The notice does not specify an email subject line.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Qualification: successfully graduated full course [Experimental Test Pilot (Rotary Wing)] from IAF TPS or any recognized Test Pilot School. More than 2000 flying hours on Rotary Wing Platforms, and current in flying. The latest break in flying on Helicopter, if any, should not exceed one year. At least two year of test-flying experience. Valid CPL(H) or ATPL(H). Preference will be given to candidates with any of: experience in production and prototype test flying; experience in weapons and EW trials; rotary-wing service qualifications such as QFI, HCL, RHS or CSQ. Medical: a current and valid medical flying category, without restrictions for helicopter operations. General requirements include sound knowledge of helicopter systems, engines, avionics, mission systems and weapon systems; operational qualifications on both twin-engine and single-engine helicopters, which is desirable for assignments involving both categories; and familiarity with military and civil airworthiness requirements. Qualification: a B.E. / B.Tech. or equivalent degree, and successfully graduated full course [Flight Test Engineer (Rotary Wing)] from IAF TPS or any recognized Test Pilot School. Minimum two years of helicopter flight-test experience as Aircrew. Desirable: experience in Civil & Military Airworthiness Certification, Systems Integration or Weapon and Electronic Warfare Integration; or experience in Certification Flight Testing of Unmanned Aircraft Systems. Medical: a current and valid medical category that permits unrestricted performance of FTE duties. If it is not current or valid, the candidate should be willing to obtain it before joining HAL. Appointment of the selected candidate is subject to a satisfactory medical report. General requirements include adequate flight-test, operational or maintenance experience on helicopters, familiarity with maintenance practices of military and civil customers, and being well versed in the current fleet of Indian military rotary-wing aircraft with sound knowledge of their systems and engines. Upper age limit for both posts: 61 years as on 10.12.2026. The notice does not list any age relaxation. The selected candidate would be paid a Monthly Consolidated Remuneration comprising last drawn Basic Pay, last drawn Dearness Allowance and House Rent Allowance on last drawn Basic Pay, Conveyance Allowance, Canteen Allowance and telephone charges. In addition, Flying-related Special Allowances [Flying Allowance, Test Pilot/Flight Test Allowance, Hazardous Flying Allowance, Civil Licence Pay (as applicable), Flying Kit Maintenance Allowance and Pre Flight Meal Allowance], including Insurance Coverage / Aircrew Clothing, as applicable to regular Pilots/FTEs, would be paid / admissible. The notice prints no rupee amount. The engagement is initially for a period of one year and extendable based on requirements, on Full Time basis. content_sections.heading: HAL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Each Flight Test Team will ordinarily comprise ETPs and FTEs. The duties printed for each post are below. Participate in PDR, CDR, TEC, JPMT and other review meetings, including EMI/EMC, DI and system safety committee meetings. Translate the operational requirements contained in the ASR into system requirement documents and measurable technical parameters. Prepare test plans to demonstrate compliance with the ASR, IMTAR, IMAP and applicable DGCA regulations. Coordinate test specifications with the FTE. The ETP will plan tests to demonstrate operational compliance while the FTE will address technical compliance. Prepare test orders and ensure they are signed by the responsible ETPs and FTEs. Conduct pre-flight briefings. Conduct flight tests in accordance with approved test plans and test orders. Conduct post-flight and data debriefings. The ETP will assess qualitative results and their correlation with operational use; the FTE will assess technical parameters and data. Coordinate with certification agencies to support certification based on flight-test results and explain the operational relevance of technical parameters. Coordinate with customers to demonstrate compliance with operational requirements based on flight-test results. Prepare and update flight manuals. Jointly with the FTE, prepare, sign and release acceptance schedules for production helicopters; the schedules used by DGAQA to certify compliance with the ASR and contractual specifications are signed by the ETP and FTE. Jointly with the FTE, prepare, sign and release acceptance schedules for civil production helicopters; the schedules used by DGCA to certify compliance with certification and contractual specifications are signed by the ETP and FTE. Serve on DI Committees, the Safety Management Cell and other relevant committees or bodies. Assist technical personnel in rectifying snags. Participate in defect investigations, Boards of Inquiry and Courts of Inquiry. Coordinate with customer units and respond promptly to technical and operational queries. Provide training to customer pilots and technicians when required under contractual commitments and when a dedicated training team is unavailable. Perform the duties of DGCA-designated instructors and examiners for the complete ALH fleet, including periodic training and competency assessments of civil-licensed ALH pilots. Participate in marketing meetings with prospective customers. Plan, coordinate and conduct outstation trials, including coordination with external agencies. Deliver lectures at professional forums including HAL Management Academy, Rotary Wing R&D Centre, NAL, ASTE and relevant seminars. Attend flight review meetings and support demonstrations of new aviation systems. Conduct customer demonstrations and display flights as required. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in HAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies in total: 4 for Consultant / Experimental Test Pilot (ETP) (Rotary Wing) and 2 for Consultant / Flight Test Engineer (Rotary Wing).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for HAL Consultant ETP and FTE posts?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of application is 10.12.2026. The application must be emailed to [email protected] on or before that date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the HAL Consultant ETP post?
faq.answer: The candidate must have successfully graduated the full Experimental Test Pilot (Rotary Wing) course from IAF TPS or any recognized Test Pilot School, with more than 2000 flying hours on Rotary Wing Platforms, at least two years of test-flying experience and a valid CPL(H) or ATPL(H).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the HAL Consultant FTE post?
faq.answer: The candidate must have a B.E. / B.Tech. or equivalent degree, must have graduated the full Flight Test Engineer (Rotary Wing) course from IAF TPS or any recognized Test Pilot School, and must have minimum two years of helicopter flight-test experience as Aircrew.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for HAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 61 years as on 10.12.2026 for both posts.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for this HAL recruitment?
faq.answer: Send the application in the enclosed format, with copies of the Age, Qualification, Flying / Flight Test Experience and Service / Relieving certificates and the last drawn Pay Slip, to the Deputy General Manager (HR) through [email protected] on or before 10.12.2026.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through an interview by the Selection Committee. Eligible candidates are shortlisted for interview based on the eligibility criteria, and documents are verified prior to the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Are HRA and other allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: House Rent Allowance on last drawn Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance, Conveyance Allowance, Canteen Allowance and telephone charges form part of the Monthly Consolidated Remuneration. Flying-related Special Allowances as applicable to regular Pilots/FTEs are paid in addition.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract engagement, initially for one year and extendable based on requirements, on Full Time basis. It confers no right to the status, facilities or benefits of a regular HAL employee.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply for these HAL posts?
faq.answer: Qualified and experienced superannuated Test Pilots and Flight Test Engineers from the Flying Branch of Indian Armed Forces / DRDO / NAL can apply.
